# statuspal-next_service (Resource)

Manages a service displayed on a StatusPal Next status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statuspal-next_status_page" "acme" {
  name        = "Acme Status"
  subdomain   = "acme-status"
  timezone    = "America/New_York"
  website_url = "https://acme.com"
}

resource "statuspal-next_service" "api" {
  status_page_subdomain = statuspal-next_status_page.acme.subdomain
  name                  = "API Gateway"
  description           = "Public REST API"
  # slug is auto-generated from name when omitted.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the service.
- `status_page_subdomain` (String) Subdomain of the status page the service belongs to. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description shown beside the service.
- `order` (Number) Position in the status page's service list (1-indexed).
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier, unique per status page. If omitted it is auto-generated from `name` (collisions get a numeric suffix).

### Read-Only

- `container_statuses` (Attributes List) Per-container live status for this service (read-only). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--container_statuses))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp at which the service was created.
- `id` (String) Server-generated identifier of the service.
- `status` (String) Computed worst-case live status across all containers: `ok`, `minor`, `major`, or `maintenance`. Live status is operational state, managed via notices in the app, not by Terraform.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp at which the service was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--container_statuses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `container_statuses`

Read-Only:

- `container_slug` (String) Slug of the container.
- `status` (String) Live status in that container.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Services are imported as "<status_page_subdomain>/<service_slug>".
terraform import statuspal-next_service.api acme-status/api-gateway
```
